title: Senior's toolkit: DevTools and the DOM APIs
summary: The browser DevTools features and DOM APIs front-end engineers use daily to find, fix and measure what the page does.

steps.title: Senior's toolkit: DevTools and the DOM APIs
steps.body: Front-end bugs are found in the browser, not in the editor. Experienced developers live in DevTools (F12) and use a small set of DOM APIs that avoid whole classes of bugs.

toolkit.what: In the DevTools Console, `$0` is the element you last selected in the Elements panel. Try a selector or a property on the real page before writing code.
flags: copy any value (as JSON for objects) to the clipboard

toolkit.what: The options object fixes the classic listener bugs: listeners that pile up, and scroll handlers that make the page janky.
flags: remove the listener when the `AbortController` aborts
remove it after the first call
promise not to call `preventDefault`, so scrolling stays smooth

toolkit.what: Event delegation: one listener on a parent handles clicks on every child, including ones added later.
flags: the nearest matching ancestor (or the target itself), or `null`

toolkit.what: Read every field of a form in one call, by its `name` attribute. Let the browser's built-in validation run before your own.
flags: a plain object of the fields
in a `submit` handler, stop the full page reload
run `required`/`type=email` checks and show the messages

toolkit.what: Stop the page where things happen, without knowing which code does it.
flags: stop at the line that throws, with every variable visible
stop in the code that changes this part of the DOM
toolkit.example: F12 > Sources > Breakpoints > tick "Pause on uncaught exceptions"

toolkit.what: See and edit what the page stores: localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies (with their `HttpOnly`, `Secure` and `SameSite` flags), IndexedDB, service workers.
flags: check flags and expiry of the session cookie
start again as a first-time visitor
toolkit.example: F12 > Application > Local storage > your origin

toolkit.what: A DevTools panel that audits a page for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO, with concrete fixes. Run it in an Incognito window so extensions do not skew it.
flags: throttled CPU and network, like a mid-range phone

steps.prompt: Every time the user opens and closes the settings panel, one click on Save sends one more request: 1, then 2, then 3. What is the cause and the fix?
options: Each open adds another listener. Add it with `{ signal }` and abort the controller when the panel closes
The browser repeats clicks on slow pages; add `{ passive: true }`
The request is retried by `fetch`; add a timeout
Use `onclick` in the HTML instead of `addEventListener`
steps.explain: `addEventListener` adds; it never replaces. `getEventListeners($0)` in the Console would show the growing list. An `AbortController` per panel opening removes them all with one `abort()`.

steps.prompt: Submitting the signup form flashes the page, and the `console.log` you added disappears before you can read it. What is happening?
options: The form does a full page reload on submit. Call `e.preventDefault()` in the submit handler (tick **Preserve log** in the Console to keep logs across reloads)
The browser blocks logs from forms for privacy
steps.explain: A form's default action is to navigate. Without `preventDefault()`, your handler runs, then the page reloads and the log is gone with it.

steps.prompt: Match each listener option to what it does.
pairs: removes the listener after the first call
removes the listener when its controller aborts
promises the handler will not call preventDefault
runs the handler on the way down, before the target

steps.prompt: Handle the form without a page reload, and read its fields as an object.
steps.explain: `stopPropagation` only stops the event from bubbling; the page would still reload. `FormData` reads every named field, including checkboxes and selects.

steps.prompt: Where in DevTools do you look first?
items: Does this selector match the elements you think it does?
An error is thrown somewhere when you click Save
Something keeps removing a list item and you do not know what
Is the session cookie set with `HttpOnly` and `Secure`?
The saved theme setting is not restored on reload
Is the page accessible to screen reader users?

steps.title: Make it a habit
steps.body: When the page misbehaves, open DevTools before the editor: try the selector with `$$`, turn on Pause on uncaught exceptions, look at storage in Application. Give every listener that can outlive its UI a `signal`, and run Lighthouse before a page ships.
